scope: 101 actual film PNGs and9 contact sheets viewed:46 ASS cue midpoints,5sec cadence and cold/stat/matchpoint/handshake/end frames. Full-film blackdetect. No audio audit or human-every-frame claim.
hash_binding: Expected new SHA verified before and after extraction and again before report; no old film frames reused.

full_canvas_live_crop.description: Sampled live frames fill1080x1440. Fixed centered3:4 agrees with source preflight; no contain borders or tracking-window change observed.

captions_above_native_board.description: Actual Chinese bottom line has visible clearance above board; English wraps upwards. Reviewed long English and near-view captions stay within canvas and avoid faces.

native_scoreboard_alpha.description: Native current score/server dot readable; width adapts between ordinary and point columns. During victory board withdrawal patch disappears. No rectangular court background or duplicated actor seen; no invented yellow header or reconstructed score.

stat_full_canvas.description: Actual162.48/162.72/165/168.48/168.60/170 display complete native stat image without ASS lowercaptions or live topbar crossing table. Names, left/right values and all rows visible. Source stat asset2160x2880 scales to1080x1440.

cold_and_english.description: Cold shows winner after matchpoint. Actual rendered English midpoints inspected across early drop comments, set-end, forehand, Incredible, ArthurFery, finalpoint and winner. Wording/audio separately owned by root/audio review.

ending_payoff.description: Actual185.80 starts matchpoint wide scene;188.16 still wide;190/191.16 winner arms;194.16 Alcaraz face;197.16/198.88/200.16 net handshake/embrace;203.12 last frame remains on court with player reaching upward. Finalrender retains source212.72–230.10 continuous ending. No endbrand, QR or interview seen.

limitations: Fixed center crop intentionally allows lateral athletes/ball to leave view; see corrected source preflight. Temporal point preservation does not assert whole-body visibility.
Sampled visualQC; blackdetect checks whole film for black spans but does not prove every frame visually perfect.
No player/action/point-win inference added; corrected serving-dot/PBP packet governs results.
